# MiSans interface font

Official unmodified MiSans VF WOFF2 subsets from Xiaomi. This directory is a
component of LIBMS Studio's interface, not a standalone font distribution.

- Source: https://cdn-font.hyperos.mi.com/font/css?family=MiSans_VF:VF:Chinese_Simplify,Latin&display=swap
- Font information and license: https://hyperos.mi.com/font/zh/download/
- Retrieved: 2026-10-14
- Original font binaries are unchanged. ui-font.css retains official unicode ranges
  and replaces external URLs with local URLs for CSP-compatible, on-demand loading.
- Apple devices prefer their installed PingFang SC and need not download MiSans.
- Interface attribution appears in the site's existing compliance disclosure.
- This font is not applied to canvas text objects or export renderers.
